nodes.title: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
nodes.trigger_detail: fires when remaining budget < T_comp = 10,240 tokens (equal to per-response cap); resume = system + summary template + last k=2 atomic (a,o) steps; at most 3 compactions; peak B_active 64k (30B) / 80k (106B)
nodes.notes: PPO jointly trains execution and summary tokens under the task reward. w/o-summary-training (compaction on, summary turns masked) recovers most of the gain: 30B SWE-Verified compacted 50.5→54.5 vs 56.0 full; 106B 59.8→64.5 vs 66.8. Summarizer swap alone swings 49.0→55.5. No-compaction RL hurts compacted inference on 30B (50.5→48.0).

nodes.title: ACM: Agentic Context Management for Long Horizon Tasks
nodes.trigger_detail: agent calls manage_context (summarize + offload raw turns to disk) and query_memory; teacher injects when redundant queries / unproductive loops / sufficient context, and replaces premature calls; GPT-5.5 almost never invokes the tools
nodes.notes: On-policy distillation: teacher top-K=20 soft labels on all assistant tokens (manage_context included); system/user/tool-output masked. Resume-from-edit after teacher annotation. ReAct 0.489 → ACM-data 0.530 → +GPT-5.5 distill 0.564 on SWE-Verified. Threshold summary agents (ReSum-style 0.475, ACON-style 0.480) underperform ReAct.

nodes.title: Context as a Tool: Context Management for Long-Horizon SWE-Agents (CaT / SWE-Compressor)
nodes.trigger_detail: callable context tool at milestones: subtask completion, strategy switch, intermediate milestones, or context-growth/error-correction heuristics (not a fixed token threshold); workspace = Q + long-term memory M(t) + last-k raw ReAct steps
nodes.notes: CaT-Generator injects context-management Actions into complete ReAct trajectories then SFT+rejection sampling (drop failed trajs and unreasonable CM). CaT-Instruct ~20k trajs, avg 4.22 CM actions, 15.6k→4.7k tokens (30%). SWE-Compressor 32B 57.6% vs ReAct 49.8 and threshold-compression 53.8 on SWE-Verified.

nodes.title: Scaling Long-Horizon LLM Agent via Context-Folding (FoldGRPO)
nodes.trigger_detail: agent calls branch(description,prompt) then return(message); intermediate branch steps folded; max 10 branches; 32K active budget; Unfolded-Token Penalty if main-thread context >50% of working limit
nodes.notes: FoldGRPO trains main+branch tokens under folded contexts with token-level process rewards (Unfolded Token Penalty, Out-of-Scope Penalty). 58.0% SWE-Verified / 62.0% BrowseComp-Plus at 32K vs 327K ReAct 55.2%. RL adds +8.8 / +20.0. Fold/return summaries are in the policy loss.

nodes.title: Self-Compacting Language Model Agents (SelfCompact)
nodes.trigger_detail: rubric probe every N tokens (math) or N tool calls (search); fire if sub-task resolved or trajectory converging; suppress mid-derivation or when stuck; fallback fixed-interval baseline at 30% of max context (MiniMax-M2.5 / WebExplorer recipe)
nodes.notes: Training-free. Rubric is load-bearing: tool-alone is uneven; removing rubric drops accuracy 46.4%→41.0% (level with fixed-interval). +18.1 math / +5–9 search at 30–70% lower cost vs no compaction.

nodes.title: Scaling LLM Multi-turn RL with End-to-end Summarization-based Context Management (SUPO)
nodes.trigger_detail: periodic: when |s_t| exceeds summarization threshold L, policy generates summary and state resets to prompt ⊕ summary; max S summarization rounds; overlong trajectories (hit H or S) are masked
nodes.notes: Summarization-augmented MDP; policy gradient decomposes into summarized sub-trajectories so standard RL infra jointly trains tool-use and summary tokens. Overlong-masking stabilizes training. +3.2 CodeGym / +14.0 BrowseComp-Plus; test-time extra summary rounds add up to +7.0.

nodes.title: ReSum: Unlocking Long-Horizon Search Intelligence via Context Summarization
nodes.trigger_detail: systematic trigger when conversation approaches the context limit (authors reject autonomous self-trigger as unreliable); WebSailor agents use 32k window; ReSum-GRPO allocates 4k query + 28k response then invokes ReSumTool-30B
nodes.notes: Training-free ReSum +4.5 vs ReAct; ReSum-GRPO +8.2 more. ReSumTool-30B is SFT-distilled on ⟨Conversation,Summary⟩ pairs (summaries ARE training targets for the compressor). ReSum-GRPO trains the explorer only: segments at summary points, broadcasts trajectory advantage; observations masked; the summary itself is produced by an external tool and is not a policy action in the explorer loss. Authors explicitly prefer RL over SFT of the explorer on ReSum trajectories.

nodes.title: AgentFold: Long-Horizon Web Agents with Proactive Context Management
nodes.trigger_detail: every intermediate step emits a folding directive (granular condensation of latest interaction, or deep consolidation of a completed multi-step sub-task) plus a tool call; ~7k tokens after 100 turns
nodes.notes: Fold-Generator + rejection sampling then conventional SFT on {context, gold structured response} including the folding block. No CPT/RL. AgentFold-30B-A3B: 36.2% BrowseComp, 47.3% BrowseComp-ZH. Folding tokens are SFT targets (preferred).

nodes.title: Memory as Action: Autonomous Context Curation for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks (MemAct)
nodes.trigger_detail: policy emits Prune&Write (IDs to delete + synthesized memory note) as an in-place edit whenever it chooses; no external token threshold
nodes.notes: DCPO splits the trajectory at each memory edit so each segment is optimized against the post-edit context (attention-masking of deleted tokens is rejected because KV still encodes them). Memory-action tokens inherit the trajectory-level GRPO advantage. MemAct-RL-14B matches 16× larger models at −51% avg context. Authors reject simple attention masking of deleted spans.

nodes.title: MEM1: Learning to Synergize Memory and Reasoning for Efficient Long-Horizon Agents
nodes.trigger_detail: mandatory every turn: emit new <IS> consolidating prior IS+query+info, then prune all previous-turn tags; constant working memory (at most two IS, two queries, one info)
nodes.notes: PPO/Reinforce++ on a reconstructed masked trajectory: 2D attention mask restores causal deps after per-turn prune; information/env tokens masked from the loss; <IS> consolidation tokens are generated and trained (preferred). No explicit memory-efficiency reward. MEM1-7B: 3.5× accuracy / 3.7× less memory vs Qwen2.5-14B on 16-objective multi-hop QA.

nodes.title: ACON: Optimizing Context Compression for Long-horizon LLM Agents
nodes.trigger_detail: history compression iff |h_t| > T_hist; observation compression iff |o_t| > T_obs; agent weights frozen; compressor prompt optimized from failure analysis
nodes.notes: Agent is not trained. Compressor is prompt-optimized then distilled: student CE on (history, compressed-history) or (obs, compressed-obs) from teacher successes — summary tokens are the distillation targets. Distilled compressor keeps 95% of teacher accuracy. −26–54% peak tokens; small LMs +20–46% by reducing distraction.

nodes.title: MemAgent: Reshaping Long-Context LLM with Multi-Conv RL-based Memory Agent
nodes.trigger_detail: document streamed in fixed chunks (paper: 5000-token chunks + 1024-token memory inside an 8K window); after each chunk the model overwrites the previous memory
nodes.notes: Multi-Conv DAPO: each chunk-update is an independent conversation; final-answer reward/advantage is broadcast to all preceding memory-overwrite generations. Memory tokens are the trained actions. Extrapolates 8K-trained model to 3.5M QA with <10% drop.

nodes.title: Memory-R1: Enhancing Large Language Model Agents to Manage and Utilize Memories via Reinforcement Learning
nodes.trigger_detail: Memory Manager runs ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP after each dialogue turn on extracted facts; not a token watermark
nodes.notes: PPO or GRPO on the manager's operation+content tokens; reward is downstream EM of a frozen Answer Agent. 152 QA pairs. Authors argue SFT is impractical because every memory op would need labels. External-bank memory, not working-context summarization.

nodes.title: COMPASS: Enhancing Agent Long-Horizon Reasoning with Evolving Context
nodes.trigger_detail: Context Manager synthesizes a progress brief each outer-loop turn; Meta-Thinker decides continue / replan / extract-answer; Main Agent runs a ReAct inner loop on the refreshed brief
nodes.notes: Hierarchical (Main / Meta-Thinker / Context Manager). Post-training pipeline delegates context management to a smaller Context-12B. Up to +20% relative on GAIA / BrowseComp / HLE vs single- and multi-agent baselines. Paper does not isolate whether brief tokens enter a student SFT loss.

nodes.title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models
nodes.trigger_detail: test-time only: when token usage exceeds 80% of the 128K window, apply Summary (summarize overflowed trajectory and re-initiate), Discard-75%, or Discard-all
nodes.notes: No compaction-aware training. BrowseComp 51.4 → 67.6 with context management. Thinking-in-tool-use keeps reasoning traces across tool rounds and discards them only on a new user message.

nodes.title: SideQuest: Model-Driven KV Cache Management for Long-Horizon Agentic Reasoning
nodes.trigger_detail: auxiliary parallel task: the LRM reasons about token usefulness and evicts stale KV; management tokens are kept off the main reasoning context
nodes.notes: 215 hindsight-annotated traces teach deletion commands. −65% peak tokens on agentic tasks. Complementary to textual summarization: operates on the KV cache.

nodes.title: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models (ACE)
nodes.trigger_detail: Generator/Reflector/Curator loop incrementally updates a playbook; no intra-episode token watermark
nodes.notes: Cross-task evolving playbook, not intra-trajectory compaction. ACM Table 1 marks ACE Compact=✗. Warns against brevity bias and context collapse from iterative rewriting.

nodes.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
nodes.trigger_detail: OS-style paging: agent functions move content between main context and archival/recall memory when the working window is pressured
nodes.notes: Foundational agent-initiated external-memory design cited by ACM and ACON. Inference-time only; no SFT/RL on compaction turns.

nodes.title: LLMLingua-2: Data Distillation for Efficient and Faithful Task-Agnostic Prompt Compression
nodes.trigger_detail: not an agent trigger: task-agnostic extractive prompt compression via a distilled token classifier
nodes.notes: ACON's extractive baseline. Student is trained with CE on keep/drop (or compressed text) labels distilled from GPT-4 — compressed representation is the training target. Not agent-history compaction.

nodes.title: WebExplorer: Explore and Evolve for Training Long-Horizon Web Agents
nodes.trigger_detail: SelfCompact/MiniMax-M2.5 cite the WebExplorer scaffold: when token usage exceeds 30% of max context, discard all history (Delete-all); 128K window, up to 100 tool turns
nodes.notes: SFT then RL on long-horizon web trajectories. The 30% discard-all recipe is the fixed-interval baseline SelfCompact beats. Paper itself is a web-agent trainer, not a compaction-loss study.

nodes.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
nodes.trigger_detail: RL infrastructure (decoupled clip, dynamic sampling); no agent compaction trigger
nodes.notes: MemAgent's Multi-Conv DAPO extends this to treat each memory-overwrite conversation as an optimization unit and broadcast the final reward — the recipe later reused conceptually by ReSum-GRPO / SUPO segment training.

nodes.title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
nodes.trigger_detail: per dialogue turn extract facts then ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP into an external store (optionally graph memory)
nodes.notes: Heuristic operator set that Memory-R1 later RL-trains. Cross-session memory, not intra-episode working-context compaction. −90% token cost vs full-context.

nodes.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models (GRPO)
nodes.trigger_detail: introduces GRPO; no compaction
nodes.notes: Base group-relative estimator reused by ReSum-GRPO, FoldGRPO, MemAct DCPO, Memory-R1. CompactionRL argues GRPO is ill-suited once compaction splits a rollout into a variable number of segments that share one reward.

gaps: No standalone paper on harness-controlled triggering + SFT-only continuation (the DSM-AE slice). Closest: CompactionRL (harness+RL), CaT/AgentFold (SFT but agent-initiated tool), ACM (distill, agent-initiated).

CaT PDF does not state whether injected context-management Action tokens vs only subsequent ReAct tokens receive SFT loss; inferred preferred because the stated goal is to learn when/how to invoke the tool.
SUPO PDF states threshold L and overlong mask but does not publish a numeric L in the extracted pages (only the formal |s_t|>L rule).
ACON does not publish numeric T_hist / T_obs in the extracted methods; only the iff-exceeds-threshold rule.
Context-Folding PDF bibliography numbering [1,19,24,34,38,43] for 'summary-based methods' was not resolved to arXiv IDs without inventing citations.
SelfCompact cites Cursor Research et al. 2026 and Anthropic /compact as industrial fixed-interval / manual triggers; those are product sources, not expanded here.
ACM comparison numbers ReSum-style 0.475 / ACON-style 0.480 vs ReAct 0.489 are ACM's reimplementation on Qwen3.5-9B, not the original papers' headline scores.

when: Harness-controlled reserve: CompactionRL fires when remaining budget < 10,240 tokens, keeps last k=2 atomic (a,o) steps, caps 3 compactions; B_active is 64k/80k not the physical window. (arxiv:2607.05378)

Near-window / percent watermarks: ReSum at approaching the context limit (32k WebSailor); DeepSeek-V3.2 at 80% of 128K (Summary / Discard-75% / Discard-all); MiniMax-M2.5/WebExplorer Delete-all at 30%; ACM's Summary-Agent figure uses ~90%. (arxiv:2509.13313, arxiv:2512.02556, arxiv:2509.06501, arxiv:2607.23809)
Periodic length threshold L: SUPO resets to prompt⊕summary whenever |s_t|>L, with a max summarization-round cap S. (arxiv:2510.06727)
Dual compressor thresholds: ACON history iff |h|>T_hist and observation iff |o|>T_obs; agent never chooses the moment. (arxiv:2510.00615)
Semantic / rubric: SelfCompact fires after a resolved sub-task or converging trajectory and suppresses mid-derivation or when stuck; rubric ablation 46.4→41.0. (arxiv:2606.23525)

Agent tool at milestones: CaT injects at subtask completion / strategy switch / milestones; AgentFold folds every step (granular vs deep); Context-Folding folds on branch completion; ACM manage_context on redundant queries / loops / sufficient context — and teacher also teaches when NOT to compact. (arxiv:2512.22087, arxiv:2510.24699, arxiv:2510.11967, arxiv:2607.23809)
Mandatory every turn: MEM1 overwrites <IS> and prunes the previous turn; MemAgent overwrites a fixed memory after every document chunk. (arxiv:2506.15841, arxiv:2507.02259)
Strong teachers do not compact voluntarily: ACM observes GPT-5.5 almost never calls manage_context / query_memory, so compaction trajectories must be constructed. (arxiv:2607.23809)
sft: Load-bearing CompactionRL ablation: exposing the policy to compacted histories while MASKING summary-response turns (w/o-summary-training) recovers most of the compacted-inference gain (30B 50.5→54.5 of 56.0; 106B 59.8→64.5 of 66.8); putting summary tokens in the PPO loss adds the remaining +1.5/+2.3. (arxiv:2607.05378)

SFT papers put compaction/fold turns IN the loss as targets: CaT SFT on injected context-management Actions (rejection-sampled CaT-Instruct); AgentFold SFT on the folding directive block; SideQuest SFT on hindsight deletion commands (215 traces). (arxiv:2512.22087, arxiv:2510.24699, arxiv:2602.22603)

ACM on-policy distillation prefers assistant tokens including manage_context (top-K=20 teacher soft labels) and masks system/user/tool-output; student is then re-rolled from the teacher-edited turn (do not reuse the original suffix). (arxiv:2607.23809)

RL explorer vs SFT compressor split: ReSum SFT-distills ReSumTool on ⟨Conversation,Summary⟩ (summaries preferred for the compressor) but ReSum-GRPO trains only the explorer on post-summary segments with observations masked and the summary produced off-policy by the external tool; authors warn explorer SFT on ReSum trajs risks overwriting skills. (arxiv:2509.13313)

Joint RL treats summary/fold/memory-edit tokens as policy actions (preferred): SUPO, FoldGRPO, MemAct DCPO, MEM1 <IS>, MemAgent overwrite, Memory-R1 ops. CompactionRL argues GRPO-style group-norm mis-weights variable segment counts, hence PPO + token-level loss + cross-trajectory GAE. (arxiv:2510.06727, arxiv:2510.11967, arxiv:2510.12635, arxiv:2506.15841, arxiv:2507.02259, arxiv:2508.19828, arxiv:2607.05378)

Do not attention-mask deleted history in place: MemAct shows deleted tokens already sit in later KVs, so DCPO physically resegments; MEM1 instead rebuilds a 2D attention mask over a concatenated trajectory — SUPO says that still cannot train beyond the reliable window. (arxiv:2510.12635, arxiv:2506.15841, arxiv:2510.06727)

Compressor-only distillation (agent frozen): ACON CE-distills (raw hist/obs → compressed text) and keeps 95% of teacher accuracy; LLMLingua-2 is the extractive analogue. (arxiv:2510.00615, arxiv:2403.12968)

Mismatch is real: no-compaction RL can hurt compacted inference (CompactionRL 30B 50.5→48.0); CompactionRL gains do not transfer to single-window eval. Mix compacted and ordinary trajectories. (arxiv:2607.05378)
